name: KrishnaDas Cash On Delivery Surcharge for WooCommerce
author: krishnadas8119

sections.description:
KrishnaDas COD Fee for WooCommerce allows store owners to add a fixed fee when customers select the Cash on Delivery payment method during checkout.

The fee is automatically added to the order total and displayed throughout the WooCommerce order process.

Perfect for stores that want to charge an additional handling or processing fee for Cash on Delivery orders.

Features

  • Add a fixed COD fee to WooCommerce orders
  • Fee applies only when Cash on Delivery is selected
  • Custom fee label
  • Custom fee amount
  • Optional taxable fee support
  • Automatic checkout total updates
  • Fee displayed in:
    • Checkout totals
    • Customer order details
    • Admin order details
    • WooCommerce emails
  • HPOS compatible
  • Lightweight and easy to configure
  • WordPress coding standards followed
  • Translation ready

Documentation

Plugin Website:
https://hmsmanager.com/krishnadas-cod-fee-for-woocommerce/

Visit the plugin website for setup instructions, screenshots, FAQs, and support resources.

Security

The plugin follows WordPress security best practices.

  • Data sanitization
  • Output escaping
  • Direct access protection
  • WordPress Settings API
  • Capability checks
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to WooCommerce → COD Fee
  4. Configure fee settings
  5. Save changes
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

When is the COD fee added?

The fee is added only when the customer selects the Cash on Delivery payment method during checkout.

Can I change the fee amount?

Yes. You can configure the fee amount from the plugin settings page.

Can I change the fee label?

Yes. You can customize the fee label displayed to customers.

Does the fee appear in admin orders?

Yes. The fee is visible in WooCommerce order details for administrators.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
